cases.detail: appendonly=yes appendfsync=everysec save='' maxmemory-policy=noeviction aof_enabled=1 aof_last_write_status=ok

cases.title: 卷丢失（最坏情况）的丢失面与后果表
cases.detail: 空卷重启前 dbsize=848，重启后 dbsize=0；逐类核对 全部丢失

celery / transcription_gpu / unacked.consequence: 队列与在途任务不执行
celery / transcription_gpu / unacked.compensation: 管线走 pipeline_dispatches outbox + 看门狗；订单走对账任务（A07-T6 实测补发）

token_blacklist:*.consequence: 已登出但未过期的 token 在窗口内重新可用
token_blacklist:*.compensation: 既有 fail-open 契约；封禁与改密仍按 DB 判定（A07-T7 实测）

video:callback:* 去重锁.consequence: 同一回调可能被重复处理
video:callback:* 去重锁.compensation: 回调处理器状态守卫 + A05 去重（幂等）

sms:cooldown:* / 会话计数.compensation: 可接受；记录为已知窗口

worker:gpu:heartbeat.consequence: GPU 心跳缺失，健康监控可能误报
worker:gpu:heartbeat.compensation: GPU 下一次心跳（30s 内）自动恢复；告警有节流

pipeline:failures:recent.consequence: 窗口内失败率统计归零
pipeline:failures:recent.compensation: 仅是速率信号；告警通道本身不依赖它

commands.cmd: docker run -d --name seeword-isolation-a07old -v seeword-isolation_a07old:/data redis:7-alpine redis-server --appendonly no --save 60 1
docker exec seeword-isolation-a07old redis-cli mset a07:t8:keep survives a07:t8:ttl survives-with-ttl
docker exec seeword-isolation-a07old redis-cli expire a07:t8:keep 900
docker exec seeword-isolation-a07old redis-cli expire a07:t8:ttl 600
docker exec seeword-isolation-a07old redis-cli rpush a07:t8:list a b c
docker exec seeword-isolation-a07old redis-cli ttl a07:t8:ttl
docker run --rm -v seeword-isolation_a07old:/from -v seeword-isolation_redisdata:/to redis:7-alpine sh -c cp -a /from/. /to/
docker run -d --name seeword-isolation-a07migrate -v seeword-isolation_redisdata:/data redis:7-alpine redis-server --appendonly no --save
docker exec seeword-isolation-a07migrate redis-cli --raw get a07:t8:keep
docker exec seeword-isolation-a07migrate redis-cli config set appendonly yes
